answer:
Shun Hing College (SHC) lists the following teams and clubs on its website, grouped by category [1][2]:

**Community Teams**
- Event Management Team (EMT) — organises college events such as High Table Dinners, International Music Festival, Halloween, Lunar New Year, Christmas and Superpass; recruits at the start of the academic year and accepts enquiries year-round [3]
- Media Team (Photography Team) — produces multimedia content; recruits year-round [4]
- Student Committee (SC) — works on resident experience and college community initiatives; also includes UG/PG Representatives and Floor Representatives [5]
- Residential Student Adviser Team (RSA) — provides academic guidance, personal support and college resource assistance [27]
- Health and Wellness Team — focuses on physical and mental health, first aid, and community health events [6]
- Social Service Team — organises social service events such as beach cleaning, bread runs, food distribution and elderly welfare programmes [7]
- Sustainability Team — promotes sustainability awareness and 3Rs practices [8]

**Art and Culture**
- Schola Cantorum [1]
- Discovery Club — guided tours of exhibitions in Hong Kong [9]
- Joint-college Dance Team — choreography, performances and workshops; open to all SHC students with over 80% attendance required to perform [10]
- Art Jamming Club — creative workshops in various art forms [11]
- Cooking Club — food and cooking workshops [12]
- Music Club — musical events, practice sessions and jam sessions [13]
- Handicraft Club — workshops including Perler beads, knitting and paper cutting [14]
- Chess Club [30]
- Drama Club [31]

**Academic Knowledge Exchange**
- Postgraduate Scholars Club — social and professional development platform for postgraduate residents [15]
- Tech Club [29]

**Sports Clubs**
- Dragon Boat Club — paddling and team-building activities [16]
- Yoga Club — yoga sessions for residents [17]
- Hiking and Camping Club — founded in 2016, encourages hiking and nature exploration [18]
- Table Tennis Club — weekly trainings for beginners and advanced players [19]
- Ice-Skating Club — welcomes beginners and professionals [20]
- Volleyball Club — training for beginners and competitive players [21]
- Football Club — weekly practices and inter-college competition [22]
- Swimming Club — regular Sunday sessions at Flora Ho Sports Centre and swimming lessons [23]
- Badminton Club — weekly training [24]
- Basketball Club — regular gatherings for girls and boys, no skill required [25]
- Running Club [28]
- Frisbee Club (Ultimate Frisbee) — welcomes beginners and professionals [26]

Note: Being listed on the website does not confirm current recruitment or activity for any group [1].

sources.title: Event Management Team
sources.text:
Shun Hing College Event Management Team
Create for common good
The Shun Hing College Event Management Team consists of a group of students who are responsible for organising college events throughout the year, both within Shun Hing and in conjunction with other colleges in Jockey Club Student Village III. We are responsible among other things for the monthly High Table Dinners, our annual International Music Festival, Halloween, Lunar New Year, Christmas and of course Superpass!
Registration
We conduct recruitment in the beginning of the academic year, so if you are interested please click on Apply Now to register using our Sign Up form in college lifts. We’ll be in touch with you shortly!
However, if you interested in joining us throughout the year, please do not hesitate to contact us throughout the year by sending us an email at
emt.shunhingcollege@gmail.com
with your details.

sources.title: Photography Team
sources.text:
SHC Media Team
Learn, create, contribute.
The SHC Media Team aims to produce multimedia content to record our lives as a big family in the college.
Here students learn from each other, produce multimedia contents and publish them online to reach the entire college community and beyond.
The Team recruits year-round and selects the best works to be used in web publications such as the official website and social media accounts.
Contact:
photo.shunhingcollege@gmail.com

sources.title: Student Committee
sources.text:
Student Committee
Of the students, by the students, for the students
Student Committee (SC)
When you join us, you will have opportunities to contribute to initiatives that enhance the resident experience and strengthen the College community.
You could help identify residents’ needs, develop new initiatives, and support projects that make College life more engaging, inclusive, and rewarding.
You could also contribute to industry talks, professional development opportunities, and other initiatives that connect residents with useful resources, experiences, and networks.
Whatever project you take part in, you will have the opportunity to work with different members of the College community, develop practical skills, and receive guidance and mentorship from the Tutorial Team.
Contact of Student Committee
shunhingsc@gmail.com
The Undergraduate and Postgraduate (UG/PG) Representatives
The Undergraduate and Postgraduate (UG/PG) Representatives are elected by the College to work alongside the Student Committee, a group of passionate people working together to advocate for resident welfare and improve the SHC experience.
Floor Representatives
Overall, the Floor Representatives (FRs) will be responsible for organizing and supporting the management of the floor, along with the Tutor in charge.
1. T
he voting/selection process for the FRs is outlined below:
Residents are encouraged to step forward as nominees. The nominees will then be put to vote, by show of hands. The nominee with the most number of votes, wins the election process.
If no resident steps forward, every resident will be put forward as a nominee. The election process will be by show of hands.

sources.title: Health and Wellness Team
sources.text:
Health and Wellness Team
Trained and reliable first aid
The SHC Health & Wellness Team is dedicated to addressing the growing need for comprehensive care in physical health, mental health, and social well-being within our community. Our mission is to raise awareness of various health issues and promote healthy living practices. We also provide immediate medical assistance for emergency situations in JCSVIII and offer support to those in need.
Our team comprises motivated medical, dental, and nursing students, doctors, healthcare researchers, and students with a passion for Health and Wellness events. We warmly welcome individuals who hold First Aid or Mental Health First Aid qualifications.
What sets us apart:
Mental Health Focus
: Mental health is a significant concern for both our team and society as a whole. We prioritize the mental well-being of our residents and the Kennedy Town community. By organizing relaxation workshops, community bonding projects, sharing talks, and mental illness screening programs, we aim to promote psychological well-being and combat the stigmatization of mental illnesses.
Community Engagement
: We believe in actively engaging with our community. Each year, we organize multiple blood donation drives, health promotion initiatives, and health check-ups in the village and throughout Hong Kong. By giving back to society and sharing our knowledge, we aim to foster understanding between citizens and students. Through these projects, our team members become more passionate and empathetic, creating a positive impact for the future.
Empowerment and Advocacy

sources.title: Social Service Team
sources.text:
Social Service Team
Dedicated to serving the community
The Social Service team is formed to provide social service in Hong Kong, contributing to the community.
We organise social service events such as beach cleaning, bread runs, food distribution and elderly welfare progams. These events not only increase the awareness of the residents of SHC on social service, but also give them a chance to contribute back to the community.

sources.title: Sustainability Team
sources.text:
Sustainability Team
Efforts to improve sustainability in our daily lives
Are you passionate about sustainability in SHC?
Are you an advocate of 3Rs (Reduce, Reuse and Recycle)?
Are you enthusiastic about preventing excessive wastage of natural resources?
Are you interested in increasing awareness about sustainability in the College through talks, documentary films, and innovative practices?
JOIN US NOW!
Contact
SHC-sustainability2022@outlook.com

sources.text:
Discovery Club
Your new journey to exhibitions in Hong Kong
Come and enjoy our guided tours of the exhibitions in Hong Kong.

sources.title: Joint-college Dance Team
sources.text:
Joint-college Dance Team
Dance is the language we all share
Joint-college Dance Team aims to enrich the residents’ cultural experience by interacting with students from around the world through a creative medium: dance. Activities include:
● Learning choreography together
● Producing dance cover/choreography videos
● Performing in various Shun Hing College events (e.g. Halloween Party, Christmas Party, Music Festival and etc.)
● Organizing “Dancing Workshops”
● Collaboration with other student parties (e.g. organizing flash-mob event with event management team)
Sub-committee members
Sub-committee members will be recruited. Their major duties are to assist the committee members in all circumstances. For example, to design poster for publicity, to design the team shirt, etc.
Note
1. All students from Shun Hing College are eligible to join the team
2. Members must be punctual for all practices and rehearsals
3. Members must come to all practices and rehearsals, unless with a valid reason.
4. In order to perform, members must have overall attendance more than 80% attendance for all practices and rehearsals

sources.title: Art Jamming Club
sources.text:
Art Jamming Club
The Art Jamming Club in Shun Hing College provides a creative and inclusive space for students to come together and express themselves through various art forms. Through regular workshops and collaborative sessions, members can explore their artistic talents, bond with like-minded individuals, and foster a vibrant artistic community within the college.
Contact Information
artjamming.shunhingcollege@gmail.com

sources.title: Cooking Club
sources.text:
Cooking Club
Make food and friends we love
An exciting club in organizing activities related to food and cooking. Join us to bring more exciting ideas in upcoming workshops at the SHC commons.

sources.title: Music Club
sources.text:
Music Club
"Ready to rock? Join SHC Music Club and let's make some noise together!", that is our motto at SHC Music Club. This club is dedicated to bringing together students who share a passion for music, regardless of their skill level or experience. The club provides a welcoming environment for students to come together, share their love for music, and hone their musical talents. The SHC Music Club organizes various musical events and performances throughout the year, creating opportunities for members to showcase their skills and engage with the wider college community.
One of the key goals of the SHC Music Club is to cultivate musicianship among the students of Shun Hing College. The club provides a platform for members to develop their musical skills through regular practice sessions and workshops led by experienced musicians. The club also organizes performances and jam sessions, giving members the opportunity to collaborate with one another and learn from each other's unique perspectives and approaches to music. Through these activities, the SHC Music Club aims to inspire a love for music and help members become more confident and proficient musicians.
If you're a student at Shun Hing College with a passion for music, we encourage you to join the SHC Music Club. Whether you're an experienced musician or just starting out, there's a place for you in our community. By joining the club, you'll have the opportunity to meet other students who share your passion for music, develop your skills, and showcase your talents. Don't miss out on this chance to be part of an active and supportive community of musicians at Shun Hing College. Come and join us today!

sources.title: Handicraft Club
sources.text:
Handicraft Club
The SHC Handicraft Club provides a warm and inclusive space
for residents to relax, express creativity, and connect through handmade activities. Open to all skill levels, the club offers regular workshops covering a variety of crafts, including Perler beads, knitting, paper cutting, and seasonal decorations. Beyond learning new skills, the club fosters meaningful friendships and a supportive creative community. We warmly welcome every resident to join us and experience the joy of
h
andicraft

sources.title: Postgraduate Scholars Club
sources.text:
Postgraduate Club
Share knowledge, collaborate work, inspire minds
The Postgraduate Scholars Club is a social platform for postgraduate residents of Shun Hing College to support each other through the rigorous academic career, and to foster academic and personal development from outside of labs and offices. We provide a relaxed and open environment to build social networks and share ideas across disciplines, as well as professional clinics and seminars with renowned guest academics to develop into successful and well-rounded scholars.

sources.title: Dragon Boat
sources.text:
Dragon Boat Club
Fun, teamwork, competition
We involve individuals in the team spirit of paddling by instilling a sense of fun and community within Shun Hing College through various other leisure activities.
With a history of over 2,000 years, dragon boat racing is a tradition deeply rooted in Chinese culture. Modern dragon boat competitions emerged as an international sport in Hong Kong in 1976, and have since spread to over 20 countries around the world.
The Shun Hing Dragons reflect the multicultural and multinational nature of the sport and College, encouraging residents of all backgrounds to participate and become part of the Shun Hing College legacy.

sources.title: Yoga Club
sources.text:
Yoga Club
Yoga is the journey of the self, through the self, to the self.
Tired after a full day of lectures, tutorials and working on assignments? Want to relax and chill out?
Yoga is a great practice for both the body and the mind, it offers peace and mindfulness and helps you get through daily stress. Every day is a great day for Yoga! Join us today!
We aim to provide yoga sessions for all Shun Hing College residents to relax and get through University life together!
Contact
shcyogaclub@gmail.com

sources.title: Hiking and Camping Club
sources.text:
Hiking and Camping Club
SHC Hiking Club was founded in 2016. We hope to form the team as the one aimed at encouraging the residents of SHC who loves hiking and climbing, to spend weekends for fun and health, and making friends with each other. Moreover, we would like to explore the other side of Hong Kong different from the urban and busy style. In order to form a united and global language applied team, we hope to attract the friends from different cultures and backgrounds to communicate. The sense of sports that is being weaved in the Shun Hing culture also encourages and supports the team to go ahead to organize better and more qualified events in the future years, providing the residents in SHC more chances to relax themselves in the nature via hiking sports.
Contact Information
SHChikeclimb@gmail.com

sources.title: Table Tennis Club
sources.text:
Table Tennis Club
Join us for our weekly trainings
Whether you’re just a beginner or looking for more serious hitters, Shun Hing College Table Tennis Club is the one for you! Join us now!
Contact
shctabletennis@gmail.com

sources.title: Ice-Skating Club
sources.text:
Ice-Skating Club
Have you ever dreamt of executing elegant spins and jumps just like the skaters you see on ice? Dream no more! Whether you have no background or are a professional, our Ice-Skating Club welcomes you to join our sessions.

sources.title: Volleyball Club
sources.text:
Volleyball Club
Join us for our trainings
Want to play as a team? Want to jump and spike? Want to dive for balls?  Want to experience volleyball? Whether you’re just a beginner or looking for serious competition, Shun Hing College Volleyball Club is the one for you! Join us now!
We aim to provide leisure for Shun Hing College residents as well as basic training for beginners who want to learn how to play volleyball.

sources.title: Football Club
sources.text:
Football Club
Shun Hing College Football Club
has organized football training since as early as the foundation of Residential Colleges. We are from different countries around the world who are all strongly fond of football and enjoy training with passion and teamwork. Our club has also attracted people from other blocks in Residential Colleges and halls and becoming a more universal football club. We are carrying out only one sole goal with different nationalities – establishing friendship with each other when enjoying football, much more than victory in games.
Football is a global language
applied by people from different cultures and backgrounds to communicate and it promotes harmony – We play together, laugh together, and cry together; we cheer for it, dream for it, and live for it. The sense of sports that is being weaved in the Shun Hing culture strengthens the friendship and the community. The team is trying its best to progress into something much greater than a mere sports team.
Our Vision
Shun Hing College Football Club dedicates to embrace all football lovers, no matter girls and boys, in Shun Hing College, provides a great opportunity for them to play together, communicate with and support each other through the weekly practices. We fight for the champion in the football season of JCSV III Residential Colleges every year and play friendly games with other hall teams, with an emphasis on safety and friendly relationships with our friends from other colleges and halls.

sources.title: Swimming Club
sources.text:
Swimming Club
Reach for the wall
The Shun Hing College Swimming Club intends to provide a platform for all swimmers to swim and improve together. All swimmers with various backgrounds from beginners to professionals are welcomed to join the club. In this semester, we will have regular practice session every Sunday at Flora Ho Sports Centre swimming pool. We will also provide swimming lessons for those who wish to learn. We have a Facebook page to keep our members informed regarding our next events!
Swimming is one of the most popular Olympic sports that burns lots of calories,increases lung capacities, supports your weight, builds muscular strength and endurance. We wish every members of the swimming club can exercise regularly while enjoying the cool refreshing pool!
Our Vision
Through this club, we wish all the members could enjoy swimming regularly, getting fitter and healthier together, to help others learn how to swim and enjoy swimming, also to learn from others as a community. Last but not least, our most important aim is for the members to have as much fun as they can while exercising the body and also make many friends in the college.

Badminton Club
Join us for weekly training
Whether you’re just a beginner or looking for more serious hitters, Shun Hing College Badminton Club is the one for you! Join us now!

Basketball Club
The Shun Hing College basketball club offers basketball gathering in a regular manner for both girls and boys. No skill is required for participation. Just bring your passion and join us now!

Ultimate Frisbee Club
You can't buy happiness but you can buy a frisbee & throw it with friends and that's pretty close
Frisbee is indeed a good form of comprehensive fitness with the requirement of teamwork. Whether you are a beginner or a professional player, you are welcome to join our Frisbee team.

Of the students, by the students, for the students
Residential Student Advisers (RSA)
We're thrilled to introduce the Residential Student Adviser (RSA) team. Our experienced and diverse RSAs are here to support you throughout your stay at our vibrant student community.
Whether you need academic guidance, personal support, or assistance with college resources, our RSAs are ready to help.

Take advantage of the support and resources our RSAs offer, whether it's academic planning, personal challenges, or simply someone to talk to. We're committed to helping you thrive during your time at Shun Hing College.
